# Avenquell Studio

> Creative and marketing studio in Charleston, SC. We diagnose what is broken in a
> brand's visuals, ads and measurement before anyone spends more on production.
> Direction before production. Diagnosis before spend.

Avenquell works in three stages: a paid diagnostic that states the problem in writing,
one-off projects scoped from that diagnosis, and monthly systems for brands that need
ongoing output. Every price is published. Human review before anything ships.

## Pages

- [Home](https://avenquell.com/): what the studio does and how an engagement starts
- [Find your starting point](https://avenquell.com/start/): a seven-question path that names one starting point, its price and its timeline
- [About](https://avenquell.com/about/): why the studio exists, where it works from, what the name carries
- [Method and Standard](https://avenquell.com/method/): six steps, two client approval gates,
  and the ten rules that decide what never ships
- [Services and Pricing](https://avenquell.com/services/): every service by stage, with its
  price, terms, guarantee and credit rules
- [Shop](https://avenquell.com/shop/): what can be bought immediately, without a call
- [Answers](https://avenquell.com/answers/): plain answers to what brands ask before hiring
- [Work](https://avenquell.com/work/): concept studies showing the method in practice
- [Concept Study 01](https://avenquell.com/work/cs01/): home fragrance launch
- [Contact](https://avenquell.com/contact/): inquiry form

## Know what is wrong — one-time, 3 to 5 business days

Answers in writing, worked from material or exports the client sends. No logins,
no account access.

- Visual Audit — $1,500 (visual review) / $2,500 (plus performance read), 3 business days
- Ad Diagnostic — $3,500, 5 business days. Includes 3-5 ad concepts. Named cause or refund.
  Not a fit when ads have run less than 2-3 months: there is not enough history to read
- Customer Analysis — from $5,000 one-time. Who buys and where they come from, read from
  the client's own exports. It does not include the buyers' language

## Decide what to say — one-time, 2 to 4 weeks

Decisions the client keeps and briefs people from. This is the part that survives a
change of contractor.

- Buyer Research — $7,500 (2 weeks) / $12,500 (4 weeks). Buyers, their language,
  competitive position, where the message needs to go. The $12,500 tier adds interviews,
  analysis of existing data, and live message testing
- Positioning — from $5,000. Segments, competitors, position and offer, as a working
  document. Built from competitors and segments, not from talking to the client's buyers

## Have it made — one project, or month to month

Scoped after diagnosis, price locked before production starts. No annual contract.

- Launch Package — from $6,500, 2-4 weeks
- Monthly Content — from $9,500/mo, two-month minimum
- Content Plan — from $5,000/mo. Plan and scripts; the client's team publishes
- Monthly Report — $2,500/mo. Built from the client's exports; analytics setup not included
- Full System — $12,500/mo (one segment) / $18,000/mo (two to three)

## Buy without a call

Two things are sold at a fixed price with no conversation, no scoping and no call. Both are
for small and medium businesses and are separate from the services above, which start at
$1,500 and are scoped before they are priced.

- The Avenquell Dispatch — $29 per edition, $49 for both. Ideas for running a sale, each
  carried by worked examples from real brands. PDF, delivered immediately after payment.
  Content edition: video, posts and pages. In-store edition: window, shelf and counter
- One Photo, One Day — from $240. The client sends one product photograph and gets three
  finished frames back inside one business day. Further frames are priced per item, falling
  with volume. Anything already paid for a Dispatch edition is credited against it in full,
  with no deadline

## Answers to common questions

Written answers, each one stating its answer in the first two sentences.

- [Why pay for a review when other studios audit for free](https://avenquell.com/answers/why-pay-when-other-studios-audit-free/):
  a free audit ends in a proposal, a paid one ends in a document the client can act on
  without us
- [How do I know the images won't look AI-generated](https://avenquell.com/answers/how-do-i-know-it-wont-look-ai-generated/):
  what makes an image read as AI is the absence of a decision, not the tool
- [Ads are running, sales aren't following — where to look first](https://avenquell.com/answers/ads-running-but-no-sales-where-to-look/):
  three checks a brand can run itself, starting with what the account counts as a conversion

## Good to know

- Based in Charleston, South Carolina. Works with brands worldwide
- Verticals: DTC fashion, beauty and skincare, boutique hospitality, wellness and supplements
- No annual contracts, no platform fee, no prepayment for the year. Cancel with 30 days notice
- Ad budgets go directly to the platforms. All ad and analytics accounts are opened in the
  client's own name
- Diagnostics work from client exports and screenshots. No account access required
- The studio does not guarantee sales, ROAS, followers or bookings, and says so on the site
